contexts.text: I will give Jacob to the curse = extirpation of the truth of the outward Church.
Accursed things = falsities and evils.
With devout prayer to the Lord.
The nations that were thus accursed.
Therefore they were given to the curse.
Such curse themselves.
All things there (with Amalek) given to the curse = that evil Genii should have no communication whatever with those of the Spiritual Church...
These are they who will be accursed, that is, cast out. AC 9193.
The casting out of the Church and thus the extirpation of such falsities is signified by being accursed. Illustrated.
What is accursed = falsity from evil. Explained.
There is no need to put on a devout aspect.

No more curse = no evil or falsity from evil that separates from the Lord... By what is accursed in the Word, is understood all that evil and falsity which separate and turn man away from the Lord, for then that man becomes a devil and a satan.
The notion that He could give mankind to the curse. TCR 134:2.
(Used in the sense of devotion.)
You could reject and curse that absurd and hurtful heresy.
Damnation, curse, and eternal death.
A devil can do this from outward devotion... but not from any inward devotion.
Pulmonary devoutness.
The notion that in Heaven their thoughts will be nothing but devotions...
The curse = total blotting out.
